answer: Make every account prove a unique audit history with spot-check bonds. Each epoch the protocol randomly re-verifies 3% of an account's past answers, and a failed re-check burns a 40-token bond. A 1,000-puppet farm faces about 30 audits per epoch, so copied or lazy output gets caught within a few epochs and costs thousands of tokens. Honest work passes cheaply. Like a dune shifting under a gale, a farm's fake record loses its shape, while each ripple of real, repeatable work stays put.
